sources.title: Open-Meteo current weather + forecast
sources.notes: Keyless JSON weather; free non-commercial use. Latitude/longitude are decimal degrees; add other 'current' or 'hourly' fields as the docs list.

sources.title: wttr.in weather (JSON)
sources.notes: Keyless plain-language weather; format=j1 returns JSON. Community-run and occasionally rate-limits or blocks on burst; keep the cadence gentle.

sources.title: USGS earthquakes (past hour, all magnitudes)
sources.notes: Keyless GeoJSON feed refreshed every minute; the response is a FeatureCollection with each quake under features[].properties (mag, place, time).

sources.title: USGS earthquakes (past day, magnitude 2.5+)
sources.notes: Keyless GeoJSON feed; fewer quakes than the all-hour feed and a longer window — a better fit for a once-per-hour dashboard tile.

sources.title: Hacker News top stories (ids)
sources.notes: Keyless JSON array of up to 500 story ids, newest-ranked first. Fetching the story titles themselves is a per-id lookup via hn-item.

sources.title: Hacker News item by id
sources.notes: Keyless JSON for one story/comment (title, url, score, by, time). Pair with hn-top-stories to render the top N titles.

sources.title: CoinGecko simple price
sources.notes: Keyless public tier is rate-limited (~10-30 req/min) and returns 429 when tripped. coin_id is CoinGecko's slug (e.g. 'bitcoin'), vs_currency is a currency code (e.g. 'usd').

sources.title: CoinGecko trending coins (24h)
sources.notes: Keyless list of the top-searched coins over the last 24 hours; same rate-limit caveat as the price endpoint (public tier, ~10-30 req/min).

sources.title: Frankfurter latest FX rates (ECB)
sources.notes: Keyless daily FX rates published by the ECB (weekdays only, no weekend/holiday update). base is a 3-letter ISO code (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD').

sources.title: Frankfurter currency list
sources.notes: Keyless map of every supported currency code to its display name. Useful for a params-picker; not for a live tile.

sources.title: mempool.space Bitcoin chain tip height
sources.notes: Keyless single integer (the current block height). Public instance is community-run and best-effort; a gentle cadence is expected.
